PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.

2. When learning Computer Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Concepts.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Concepts.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Concepts.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Concepts.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

4. When learning Safety in the Immediate Environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the Immediate Environment.

5. When learning Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials.

6. When learning Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.

7. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools.

8. When learning ICT Tools in Communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for ICT Tools in Communication.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ICT Tools in Communication.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ICT Tools in Communication.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ICT Tools in Communication.

9. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   D. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

12. When learning Non- Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Non- Metallic Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Non- Metallic Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Non- Metallic Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Non- Metallic Materials.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in the Immediate Environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Concepts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
